newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's IGCP places no floaters at auction.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's IGCP places no floaters at auction.

text.p: Portugal's Institute for Public Credit Management (IGCP) said it did not place any 2004 OTRV floating rate bonds at today's auction.

An official source of the IGCP said demand was 51.75 billion escudos, the maximum offered price was 9,965 escudos, the minimum price was 9,850 escudos and the average offered price was 9,925.25 escudos.
At the last auction on January 27, the IGCP placed 11.5 billion escudos of 2004 ORTV floaters at an average weighted price of 9,962.48 escudos.
The 2004 OTRV are indexed to six-month Lisbor minus 25 basis points. Their maturity date is July 30 2004.
The IGCP had proposed to auction 25 billion escudos of the floaters today.
